# development-finance

> Python client for the Development Finance Observatory (DFO) APIs. `dfo.search(question)` returns an `Answer` that says, in Search's sentence, what DFO understood a plain-language question about development finance (ODA, debt, GDP and similar indicators) to mean; `print(answer)` shows the sentence and the next line to type. `answer.fetch()` builds and downloads a versioned table as a `Dataset`. Install with `pip install development-finance`; import as `dfo`. Python 3.12 or later.

An answer holds readings and no data. When a part of the question has several readings, `print(answer)` and the `dfo.errors.IncompleteAnswerError` that `fetch` raises end with a `Choose:` line such as `answer.choose(0).fetch()`. The order of readings can change between searches, so a script keeps `data.ref` and leaves the index out. A table of flows leaves out group and total rows by default, so a sum counts each party once; `party_totals=True` keeps them. Columns come in reading order: year, parties, value, unit, then the columns that vary between rows, then the constant ones, with `stat_var` last. Rows sort by those columns and then the year, so each series reads in time order. Every error derives from `dfo.errors.DfoError`, carries a `code`, and ends its message with `[code · trace id]`, or `[code]` when the error has no trace id.

Main calls:

- `dfo.search(question, *, timeout=60.0) -> Answer`; `answer.sentence`, `answer.parts`, `answer.specs`, `answer.complete`, `answer.gaps`
- `answer.choose(option, *, part=None) -> Answer`: settle a part with several readings, or a place that matches several, by index, label, or the option's line as `print(answer)` shows it (a candidate's `label · source · unit`); a closing full stop is ignored. One Search request
- `answer.fetch(*, partial=False, window=None, entities=None, facets=None, strict=False, layout="long", party_totals=False, timeout=None, progress=None) -> Dataset`. `window`, `entities` and `facets` narrow every reading as `dfo.fetch` narrows one spec. No deadline unless `timeout=`; Ctrl-C leaves the build running and the same fetch joins it
- `dfo.fetch(spec_or_ref, *, window=None, entities=None, facets=None, layout=None, party_totals=None, latest=False, strict=False, timeout=None, progress=None) -> Dataset`. `window` is `(start, end)` with years from 1000 to 2200, `"latest"` or `"all"`; `layout="frame"` returns one reading's pipeline frame; `entities` maps a spec's role keys, listed in `spec.roles` (`place`, `origin`, `destination`), to place codes; a key the spec does not take raises before any request
- `Dataset`: `to_pandas()`, `to_polars()`, `to_arrow()`, `pyarrow.table(data)`, `len(data)`, `save(path)`, `ref`, `members`, `sentence`, `citation`, `complete`, `missing`, `stale`
- `dfo.load(path) -> Dataset`: a file `data.save` wrote, or a website bundle
- `dfo.fetch(data.ref)` returns the same versions; `dfo.fetch(data.ref, latest=True)` the newest, and `new.ref != old.ref` tells whether the data changed
- `answer.to_json()` and `dfo.Answer.from_json(text, client=None)`: keep or share an answer and choose later
- `dfo.lookup.resolve(*names, kinds=None, code_system=None, expand_members=False) -> list[Match]`, one per name: `text`, `status` (`resolved`, `ambiguous`, `not_found`, `not_held`), `entity` (`dcid`, `name`, `kind`; set for `resolved` and `not_held`), `candidates`, `near_matches`, `raw`; `print(match)` shows `Germny -> not found; nearest: Germany  country/DEU`. `dfo.lookup.node(dcid, *, as_of=None) -> Node`, `dfo.lookup.code(code) -> Code` (`definition`), `dfo.lookup.catalogue(place=None) -> Catalogue` (`counts`, `examples` as question strings); each keeps `raw`. `client.lookup` on a client
- `dfo.Client(*, api_key=None, base_url=None, timeout=30.0, max_retries=2, cache_dir=None, cache=True, headers=None, header_provider=None)`, a context manager with `search`, `fetch` and `lookup`; `client.with_options(timeout=, max_retries=)` returns a copy that shares its connections and cache. `dfo.AsyncClient` mirrors it, and `dfo.configure(...)` replaces the default client
- Modules: `dfo.errors` (errors and warnings), `dfo.types` (parts, candidates, gaps, members, lookup results), `dfo.lookup`, `dfo.auth`
- CLI: `dfo auth login [--with-token]`, `dfo auth status`, `dfo cache clear`
- Environment: `DFO_BASE_URL`, `DFO_API_KEY`, `DFO_PROFILE`, `DFO_CREDENTIALS_FILE`, `DFO_CACHE_DIR`, `BBLOCKS_CACHE_DIR`, `DFO_OFFLINE=1`, `DFO_PROGRESS=0`

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, the first five lines, and a recipe per task: choose, other years or places, totals, save and load, refresh, share, place codes
- [Answers and choices](docs/answers.md): parts, `choose`, `partial=True`, `SearchWarning` and `strict`, `to_json`, declined answers, gap kinds
- [Datasets and versions](docs/datasets.md): `window`, `entities`, `facets`, layouts, `party_totals`, conversions, refs, retention, `save` and `load`
- [Long builds](docs/long-builds.md): progress, deadlines, Ctrl-C
- [Errors](docs/errors.md): every error class and code, and warnings
- [Keys and credentials](docs/keys.md): key lookup order, `dfo auth login`, the credentials file
- [The cache](docs/cache.md): layout, `DFO_CACHE_DIR`, `DFO_OFFLINE`, stale reads
